title: Aquamarinus' Reforge
description: A creative Minecraft texture project reimagining 58 item textures and 226 block textures. items with fresh palettes, unique detailing, and original designs that preserve the recognizable spirit of vanilla while shaping a new, cohesive visual world.”
body:
**Hello! I’m Aquamarinus, my name is Andrey, and I’m working on a project aimed at creating unique textures for Minecraft. My goal is to make the blocks completely new and original, while still preserving the spirit of the vanilla game. I want to create textures that will feel like part of a new, authorial world, but without losing their recognizability and connection to the classic Minecraft.
All the textures I’m working on will be redesigned with new details and depth. I’m using an expanded color palette, more thoughtful detailing, and unique textures to make the blocks feel fresh and modern, while still being recognizable as Minecraft elements. Each texture will work harmoniously with other elements of the game, creating a cohesive and original visual style.
The project is still in development, and I am still working on resprite many of the game elements. My goal is to create blocks that feel like part of the game, while still maintaining what makes Minecraft unique and loved.
Contents
Currently, my Minecraft project includes 55 item textures and 179 block textures. I’m continuing to work on updating and improving the textures to maintain the essence of the vanilla game while making them look fresh and original.**
